map.进度 = (1 − 剩余秒数 ÷ 总秒数) × 100%；已用时长 = 总时长: Progress = (1 − remaining seconds ÷ total seconds) × 100%; elapsed time = total duration − remaining time. Interval reminders help you divide answering and checking time sensibly.
map.，训练时间分配: for the real exam length to practise time allocation
map.分段作答：用提醒节点切分答题、检查阶段: Segmented answering: use reminder points to split the answering and checking phases
map.限时训练：给单题或单模块设定倒计时: Timed practice: set a countdown for a single question or module
map.例：设定考试总时长 120 分钟；建议前 90 分钟作答、留 30 分钟检查。到: Example: set the exam length to 120 minutes; a good split is 90 minutes answering and 30 minutes left for checking. An early reminder (for example at 15 minutes remaining) avoids rushed answer sheets and missed questions.
map.支持暂停与继续，中断时间不计入已用时长；模考时建议全程不暂停，以贴近真实考场节奏: Pause and resume are supported, and the paused time is not counted as elapsed time; for a mock exam it is better not to pause at all, to stay close to real exam conditions.

map.计时依赖当前页面运行，切换后台或锁屏可能被系统节流；重要模考请在常亮屏幕上运行，: Timing depends on this page running, so backgrounding or locking the screen may be throttled by the system. Run important mock exams with the screen always on, or keep an alarm as a fallback.

map.每秒把剩余秒数减 1；小时 = floor(剩余 ÷ 3600)，分钟 = fl: Each second the remaining seconds decrease by 1; hours = floor(remaining ÷ 3600), minutes = floor((remaining mod 3600) ÷ 60), seconds = remaining mod 60; when remaining reaches zero the timer is cleared and put into the stopped state; on start, if remaining is 0 it is first reset to the configured total duration and the start record is written to history
